Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Job Description

Visa is seeking a Product Marketing Manager to join the CEMEA Product Marketing team, supporting the Visa Consumer App and Benefits portfolios. This role sits at the center of two interlocking growth stories: marketing the benefits that make Visa cards worth holding, and growing Visa’s consumer apps user base from download to daily habit. We're looking for someone who can go deep enough into the product to understand why it matters and where it fits competitively, while translating that understanding into sharp, consumer-facing narratives, issuer-facing toolkits, and campaign strategy that drives measurable growth (downloads, MAU, redemption, etc).

The right candidate is equally comfortable running a two-way working model with Product, feeding market-level consumer insight into benefit prioritization, as they are building a DTC app-acquisition campaign. This role combines product and consumer-app growth instincts with strong storytelling and campaign execution, and requires comfort working across product managers, regional marketing teams, issuers, and creative/media partners in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the marketing plan for Visa’s consumer apps growth, driving app downloads and MAU through DTC and issuer-led (B2B2C) campaigns.

• Prioritize all CEMEA benefits across five pillars (Travel, Dining, Wellness, Entertainment, Sports) and translate sourced benefits into GTM plans that maximize cardholder awareness and redemption.

• Build and maintain the editorial strategy and guidelines for Visa’s consumer apps across CEMEA markets, and support regional and market-specific launch plans for any upcoming app launches

• Translate consumer behavior data into sharper campaign and content decisions across the funnel, working closely with Media and Creative teams to maximize app performance.

• Partner with regional marketing, issuer teams, and creative/media agencies to localize global toolkits, campaign platforms, and content into market-relevant activation.

• Support product and campaign launches through messaging development, sales/issuer enablement content, and go-to-market sequencing.

• Leverage AI tools and modern workflows to accelerate research, analysis and reporting, while maintaining high standards of accuracy and market relevance.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

• 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.

• Experience in product marketing, growth marketing, consumer app marketing, loyalty/benefits marketing, or a related field.

• Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, digital wallets, loyalty & rewards, or other consumer-facing B2C/B2B2C environments.

• Demonstrated ability to translate product capabilities and consumer insight into clear, compelling, growth-oriented campaigns and content.

• Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with experience creating materials for consumer, issuer/partner, and internal executive audiences.

• Experience collaborating across product, regional marketing, partner/issuer, and creative/media teams in a matrixed organization.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple portfolios and market priorities simultaneously.

• Ability to influence stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and drive initiatives forward without direct authority.

• Fluency with AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)

• Strong knowledge of the CEMEA payments ecosystem, including issuers, benefits/loyalty programs, and emerging-market consumer app growth (Africa, Middle East, or comparable markets).

• Experience running consumer app growth funnels (acquisition, activation, retention) with ownership of KPIs such as downloads, MAU, and active-rate conversion.

• Experience with benefits marketing, loyalty programs, or working in a two-way operating model with Product to prioritize customer-facing offerings.

• Experience developing DTC and B2B2C toolkits, issuer/partner enablement content, launch materials, or editorial content strategies.

• Experience working closely with product managers, regional marketing teams, and creative/media agencies to localize global platforms for market relevance.

• Ability to interpret consumer and app performance data to inform campaign and content decisions.

• Strong business judgment and ability to balance brand consistency, market relevance, and commercial/growth outcomes.

**Senior Editor, HarperNonFiction**

**Application Deadline:** 17 October 2026

**Department:** Editorial

**Employment Type:** Permanent

**Location:** London

**Reporting To:** Susanna Abbott

**Compensation:** £36,000 - £40,000 / year

**Description**

**Are you a creative, commercially minded editor ready to take the next step up in your publishing career? HarperNonFiction is looking for a dynamic, detail-driven individual to join our Thorsons, Lifestyle, Gift & IP Editorial team.**

HarperNonFiction is home to a wide range of bestselling authors and is one of the UK’s leading commercial non-fiction publishing divisions. Notable Thorsons, Lifestyle, Gift & IP successes include titles by Ben Lippett, Jay Shetty, Sarah Rossi, Becky Kennedy, the Royal Shakespeare Company and Freja.

As a successful candidate, you will possess strong desk editorial skills and have a proven track record of overseeing books from first manuscript, through copy-editing and proofreading all the way to final PDF. You will also possess excellent commercial instincts and be able to demonstrate strong market knowledge of lifestyle, cookery and gifts. A genuine passion for cookery and lifestyle as well as experience of working on illustrated cookery would be a distinct advantage. You will also be highly organised, proactive and confident juggling competing priorities, whilst delivering exceptional publishing and author care. In addition, you will be an excellent communicator and enjoy working co-operatively within our collaborative and supportive team. As your confidence grows in the role, you will have the opportunity to commission a small number of your own titles, making this an exciting opportunity for an ambitious editorial professional.

**Your first six months**

By the end of six months you would be managing projects confidently – including copywriting, structural edits, cover briefs and proofreading. You’ll also be encouraged to contribute book ideas and to share feedback on proposals with a longer-term view to commissioning 2–3 titles a year in the areas of Cookery and Lifestyle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Editorial**

+ Support the Thorsons, Lifestyle, Gift & IP Editorial commissioning team across a range of titles from manuscript to finished copies, maintaining the highest standards of quality, accuracy and editorial integrity – on budget and on schedule

+ Take project management and desk editorial responsibility for the Publisher's titles, including structural editing, overseeing copy-edits, checking proofs, copywriting and writing design briefs

+ Manage budgets, schedules and critical paths with precision and foresight

+ Build and maintain strong working relationships with authors, agents and freelancers, including editors, indexers and photographers

+ Prepare cover briefs, write compelling cover copy and information sheets, and check proofs to a high standard

+ Copywrite and review sales and marketing materials, including catalogues and presenter documents

+ Manage editorial listings (TIs, BIC, Acquisitions, P&Ls) to ensure title and list information is accurate and up to date, both internally and externally

+ Research and prepare pitch presentations for new business opportunities, collaborating with internal and external designers as needed

+ Stay ahead of publishing trends and market developments, with an instinct for identifying what's coming next

+ Take ownership of your own stable of authors, seeing their titles through to publication across physical, digital and audio editions

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

+ Demonstrable editorial experience across commercial non-fiction books, including both black-and-white and illustrated titles

+ Proven copy-editing and proof-reading skills

+ A keen eye for detail and strong visual awareness

+ Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage a varied workload across both short and long-term demands

+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing catalogue and cover copy

+ Financial awareness, with confidence in budgeting and cost-control processes across specific projects and lists

+ A self-motivated, proactive approach – able to take initiative and see projects through independently

+ The ability to remain calm and focused under pressure

+ A collaborative team player with the drive to work autonomously when needed

+ A passion for innovative publishing, meaningful content and beautifully produced books

+ An active interest in trends, talent, social media and digital developments within the industry

+ An excellent command of the English language

+ A customer-focused mindset, with a commitment to delivering the highest standard of author care

+ Advanced proficiency in MS Word; intermediate knowledge of Excel and Outlook

**Job Benefits**

HarperCollins operates a hybrid working policy where employees are expected to work from our London office three days per week.

If you wish to discuss anything regarding this position, please contact recruitment@harpercollins.co.uk with the subject line 'Vacancy Query' followed by the job title. We aim to respond within 5 working days.
